content_sections.heading: CSCCC IIM Raipur Senior Project Associate Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSCCC IIM Raipur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CSCCC IIM Raipur Senior Project Associate Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: SeniorProject Associate: Masters in Computer Applications/MSc (Computer Applications) or Bachelors in Engineering / Technology (CSE/IT or related field) from a recognized University or Equivalent, Doctoral degree in Computer Science/ Information Technology from a recognized University or Equivalent. Experience: Four years of experience in Website Development and Management, Dashboard/Application Development and Management, Data Compilation and Analysis, Web Content Management, Programming, Software Development, and Design-related Activities.

content_sections.text: Senior Project Associate: Rs. 42,000/- Per month + HRA

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSCCC IIM Raipur Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Chhattisgarh State Center for Climate Change (CSCCC IIM Raipur) for filling up research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Senior Project Associate under the Chhattisgarh State Center for Climate Change recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is conducted entirely via a Walk-in Interview mode. Eligible candidates can directly attend the interview venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Project Associate position is scheduled to take place on 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters in Computer Applications/MSc (Computer Applications) or Bachelors in Engineering/Technology (CSE/IT) or Doctoral degree in Computer Science/Information Technology along with relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years, with applicable age relaxations provided for reserved category candidates such as SC/ST/OBC and women.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Project Associate post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month along with HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidates will be Naya Raipur in the state of Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all relevant original educational and experience documents along with a one-set photocopy and a passport-size photograph to the walk-in interview.
